282858125.description:
Natural Crystal Geode Specimens Lot - 2 Pieces
Amethyst and Quartz Mineral Displays
This pair of natural mineral specimens showcases distinct crystal formations. The lot includes a purple amethyst crystal cluster featuring sharp terminations over a natural rock matrix, alongside a hollow quartz geode half lined with sparkling crystalline druzy. These natural geological display pieces make striking accents for any mineral collection, study, or home decor setting.
Items Included:
Purple Amethyst Specimen: Natural cluster of lilac to violet quartz crystal points with exposed rough matrix and celadonite basalt backing
Quartz Geode Half: Hollow geode specimen with a rough tan exterior rind opening into an interior cavity lined with clear and white quartz crystals
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in raw, unpolished condition. Both pieces display natural crystalline formations, textural variations, and rough matrix edges with no visible artificial repairs or enhancements.

Geology & Mineral Specimen Collection Lot - Approximately 45 Pieces
Natural & Polished Gemstones, Crystals, Agates, and Mineral Specimens
Mixed Formations and Lapidary Cuts
This diverse geological study and display lot features an assortment of natural raw crystals, lapidary polished gemstones, carved towers, and display stones. Carved crystal obelisks, including rose quartz towers
